commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

90+2' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Dean Henderson makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
90' Corner kicks – 8:6.
89' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

77' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Dean Henderson dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd). Now Newcastle have a corner.

77' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.

69' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle have a free kick from a promising distance.
69' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

68' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) will take a corner kick.

18' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but it's cleared.
